credentials.description: license key, sent as Authorization: Basic <license key> (the key as is, not base64 of user:password)
website ID of your LengoPay account, sent with the request (body field websiteid, or path segment for get_balance), separate from the license key

example_prompt: Add a LengoPay payment request to my checkout.

websiteid.description: Unique identifier of your site, provided by LengoPay (separate from the license key).

amount.description: Payment amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. E.g. GNF, XOF, USD.

return_url.description: URL to return to the merchant's site after payment (optional).

callback_url.description: URL that LengoPay will call with a POST when the payment is processed (optional).

metadata.description: Arbitrary data passed at creation, returned unchanged in verify_payment and the webhook. Useful for storing an internal order ID.

status.description: Request status. 'Success' if the payment URL was generated.

pay_id.description: Unique payment identifier. Store it before redirecting — required to call verify_payment.

payment_url.description: URL to redirect the user to in order to complete the payment.

gotchas: Store pay_id immediately before redirecting the user — it is the only identifier for calling verify_payment and confirming the payment server-side.
The Authorization header expects the license key directly: 'Basic {license_key}'. This is not standard Basic Auth (no base64 username:password) — pass the key as is.
websiteid is a required parameter, separate from the license key. Both must be configured as separate environment variables.
There is no sandbox. All calls hit production — use small amounts for testing.
open_questions: Is a retried create_payment safe? LengoPay's docs are not public (lengopay.com answers 403 to non-browser requests) and no idempotency key or duplicate handling is documented for this call.
